name: Sayonara: Dreams of Letting Go
source:
After the tragic suicide of Sayori and a subsequent traffic accident, our protagonist is transported several years into the past where he appears to relive his childhood alongside his best friend Sayori. With vague memories of what's to come, our protagonist must find a way to manipulate the past to overcome the inevitability of his best friend's death. All the while a certain someone observes from beyond.

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/sayonara-dreams-of-letting-go]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
挚友纱世里不幸自杀，随后主人公又遭遇车祸。之后，他被送回数年前，似乎要与挚友纱世里重温童年时光。主人公只记得模糊的未来，于是必须想办法改写过去，打破挚友死亡的宿命。与此同时，某个人正从彼岸注视着一切。

[摘自[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/sayonara-dreams-of-letting-go]DokiMods[/url]]
